partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Adverse-gated top-five causal-module coverage
results.hypothesis: Top-five module coverage is stronger after excluding explicit graph-native contraindication, exacerbation, or disease-causing evidence.
results.body: R247 excluding direct contraindicated-in, exacerbates-condition, or causes edges
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule preserves broad high-ranked target coverage while removing an explicit adverse disease relation.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; negative existential logic, rank, cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 5
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }

WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 3
RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
